full_query: If this is just muscle strain, how many days should I expect the pain to go away?

shared_context.topic: expected duration of pain from muscle strain

sentences: Muscle strain is a common injury that can be caused by overuse, overstretching, or direct blows to the muscle
The duration of pain from muscle strain can vary depending on the severity of the injury and the individual's overall health
Mild muscle strains typically resolve on their own within 7-14 days
However, more severe strains may take longer to heal, often requiring 4-6 weeks or more for full recovery
Factors that can influence the healing time include the location of the strain, the severity of the injury, and the effectiveness of treatment
For example, strains in the lower back may take longer to heal than those in the upper body
It's essential to note that if the pain persists or worsens over time, it may be a sign of a more serious underlying condition, such as a herniated disc or a stress fracture
In such cases, medical attention should be sought
